changelog:
- Native Document-Start Script Execution: Injected adshield engine via WebViewCompat.addDocumentStartJavaScript before any page script executes.
- Pre-Emptive YouTube Player Cleanser: Sanitizes window.ytInitialPlayerResponse and /youtubei/v1/player JSON to eliminate 'Sponsored 1 of 2 0:00' ad screens.
- Instagram Feed & GraphQL Ad Filter: Dynamic GraphQL query filtering removing sponsored media and paid partnerships before timeline rendering.
- Full-Bleed Floating Command Bar: Fullscreen viewport with zero dead space and smart idle auto-reappearance.
